title: Jürgen Symanzik
text:
Dr. Symanzik joined Utah State University’s Department of Mathematics and Statistics in 1999. He holds degrees in Statistics (1991) and Computer Science (1992) at the MS level (Universität Dortmund, Germany) and a co-major PhD (1996) in these two fields (Iowa State University, Ames, Iowa). His research interests include all forms of statistical graphics and visualization, e.g., static/dynamic/interactive, on the Web, in a geographical framework, and applied to educational and medical data.
On this site, you can find a list of my publications, my presentations, classes I taught, and my CV.
